property_summary: For any caller who is the contract owner and any nonzero amount, after calling sendTo(receiver, amount) the reference contract always decreases address(c).balance by amount and increases the specified receiver's balance by amount; the mutant instead sends to msg.sender, so when owner != receiver and amount>0 the receiver's balance does not increase by amount (the property that receiver's balance increases by amount is violated).
change_summary: Replace the transfer call with sending funds to msg.sender instead of the provided receiver, altering who receives funds observed after sendTo.
